description: Truy vấn chỉ đọc; kết quả đầy đủ giữ local. Chạy discovery rồi xác nhận exact identity trước các phép đo membership.

queries.statement: CALL dbms.components() YIELD name, versions, edition RETURN name, versions, edition
queries.description: Phiên bản Neo4j thực tế của database.

queries.statement: MATCH (n) RETURN count(n) AS nodes, count(DISTINCT n.objectid) AS unique_objectids
queries.description: Tổng node và objectid duy nhất; không suy equality của tập identity.

queries.statement: MATCH (n) RETURN labels(n) AS labels, count(n) AS count ORDER BY labels
queries.description: Population theo labels.

queries.statement: MATCH ()-[r]->() RETURN type(r) AS type, count(r) AS count ORDER BY type
queries.description: Multiplicity lưu trữ theo relationship type.

queries.statement: MATCH (g:Group) RETURN g.objectid AS objectid, g.name AS name, labels(g) AS labels, properties(g) AS properties ORDER BY objectid
queries.description: Tập Group đầy đủ; giữ output local theo data policy.

queries.statement: MATCH (n) RETURN n.objectid AS objectid, labels(n) AS labels ORDER BY objectid
queries.description: Tập identity mọi node; chưa kết luận parity toàn graph.

queries.statement: MATCH (s)-[r:MemberOf]->(t) RETURN s.objectid AS source, t.objectid AS target, properties(r) AS properties ORDER BY source, target
queries.description: Tập MemberOf lưu trữ; direct/effective semantics toàn tập chưa nghiệm thu.

queries.statement: MATCH (n) WHERE toString(n.objectid) CONTAINS $sid RETURN labels(n) AS labels, n.objectid AS objectid, n.name AS name, properties(n) AS properties ORDER BY objectid
queries.description: Chỉ discovery; không dùng CONTAINS để kết luận identity.

queries.statement: MATCH (n) WHERE n.objectid = $exact_objectid RETURN labels(n) AS labels, n.objectid AS objectid, n.name AS name, properties(n) AS properties
queries.description: Xác nhận objectid chính xác và properties thực tế.

queries.statement: MATCH (n) WHERE n.objectid = $exact_objectid OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r:MemberOf]->(parent) RETURN labels(n) AS labels, n.objectid AS objectid, n.name AS name, type(r) AS type, labels(parent) AS parent_labels, parent.objectid AS parent_objectid, parent.name AS parent_name, properties(r) AS relationship_properties ORDER BY parent_objectid
queries.description: MemberOf đi từ principal tới parent.

queries.statement: MATCH (child)-[r:MemberOf]->(n) WHERE n.objectid = $exact_objectid RETURN labels(child) AS child_labels, child.objectid AS child_objectid, child.name AS child_name, type(r) AS type, labels(n) AS labels, n.objectid AS objectid, n.name AS name, properties(r) AS relationship_properties ORDER BY child_objectid
queries.description: MemberOf đi từ child tới principal.

queries.statement: MATCH (n)-[r]-(m) WHERE n.objectid = $exact_objectid RETURN n.objectid AS objectid, type(r) AS type, startNode(r).objectid AS source, endNode(r).objectid AS target, labels(m) AS other_labels, m.objectid AS other_objectid, m.name AS other_name, properties(r) AS relationship_properties ORDER BY type, source, target
queries.description: Mọi quan hệ trực tiếp quanh principal, bảo toàn chiều.

queries.statement: MATCH (n) WHERE toString(n.objectid) CONTAINS $sid RETURN labels(n) AS labels, n.objectid AS objectid, n.name AS name, properties(n) AS properties ORDER BY objectid
queries.description: Chỉ discovery; không dùng CONTAINS để kết luận identity.

queries.statement: MATCH (n) WHERE n.objectid = $exact_objectid RETURN labels(n) AS labels, n.objectid AS objectid, n.name AS name, properties(n) AS properties
queries.description: Xác nhận objectid chính xác và properties thực tế.

queries.statement: MATCH (n) WHERE n.objectid = $exact_objectid OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r:MemberOf]->(parent) RETURN labels(n) AS labels, n.objectid AS objectid, n.name AS name, type(r) AS type, labels(parent) AS parent_labels, parent.objectid AS parent_objectid, parent.name AS parent_name, properties(r) AS relationship_properties ORDER BY parent_objectid
queries.description: MemberOf đi từ principal tới parent.

queries.statement: MATCH (child)-[r:MemberOf]->(n) WHERE n.objectid = $exact_objectid RETURN labels(child) AS child_labels, child.objectid AS child_objectid, child.name AS child_name, type(r) AS type, labels(n) AS labels, n.objectid AS objectid, n.name AS name, properties(r) AS relationship_properties ORDER BY child_objectid
queries.description: MemberOf đi từ child tới principal.

queries.statement: MATCH (n)-[r]-(m) WHERE n.objectid = $exact_objectid RETURN n.objectid AS objectid, type(r) AS type, startNode(r).objectid AS source, endNode(r).objectid AS target, labels(m) AS other_labels, m.objectid AS other_objectid, m.name AS other_name, properties(r) AS relationship_properties ORDER BY type, source, target
queries.description: Mọi quan hệ trực tiếp quanh principal, bảo toàn chiều.

queries.statement: CALL dbms.components() YIELD name, versions, edition RETURN name, versions, edition
queries.description: Kiểm chứng structural projection của project; assessments vẫn ở JSON.

queries.statement: MATCH (n:Canonical) RETURN count(n) AS nodes, count(DISTINCT n.id) AS unique_ids
queries.description: Kiểm chứng structural projection của project; assessments vẫn ở JSON.

queries.statement: MATCH (:Canonical)-[r]->(:Canonical) RETURN type(r) AS type, count(r) AS count ORDER BY type
queries.description: Kiểm chứng structural projection của project; assessments vẫn ở JSON.

queries.statement: MATCH (n:Canonical:Group) RETURN n.id AS id, n.label AS label, n.domain AS domain, n.is_boundary AS is_boundary ORDER BY id
queries.description: Kiểm chứng structural projection của project; assessments vẫn ở JSON.

queries.statement: MATCH (n:Canonical) WHERE n.is_boundary = true RETURN labels(n) AS labels, properties(n) AS properties ORDER BY n.id
queries.description: Kiểm chứng structural projection của project; assessments vẫn ở JSON.

queries.statement: MATCH (n:Canonical)-[r]-(m:Canonical) WHERE n.is_boundary = true RETURN n.id AS id, type(r) AS type, startNode(r).id AS source, endNode(r).id AS target, properties(r) AS properties ORDER BY id
queries.description: Kiểm chứng structural projection của project; assessments vẫn ở JSON.

queries.statement: MATCH (n:Canonical) RETURN n.graph_digest AS graph_digest, n.snapshot_id AS snapshot_id, count(n) AS count
queries.description: Kiểm chứng structural projection của project; assessments vẫn ở JSON.

queries.statement: MATCH (:Canonical)-[r]->(:Canonical) RETURN r.graph_digest AS graph_digest, r.snapshot_id AS snapshot_id, count(r) AS count
queries.description: Kiểm chứng structural projection của project; assessments vẫn ở JSON.

queries.statement: MATCH (:Canonical)-[r]->(:Canonical) RETURN count(r) AS count, sum(CASE WHEN r.provenance_json IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS with_provenance
queries.description: Kiểm chứng structural projection của project; assessments vẫn ở JSON.
